notes.title: Update 1.2.0 (Or is it 1.0.4? I don't know anymore!)
notes.content:
[h3][b]Its been a while! 
[/b][/h3]
Unfortunately one of our Crogs bunt all the patch notes for this build so we can't provide anything specific other than the fact he was executed and the patch drops now.

Some of the features we know of that wasn't burnt are:

- A variety of new items items of all tiers, from extra projectiles to massive stat buffs across the board
- Additions to the slots mechanics to flesh it out, a power-up for slot odds, new type of slot, and more. (Brodie will love this one!)
- A good helping of bug fixes (There might be more made from this update than removed, that's just how these crogtoons go sometimes ¯\_(ツ)_/¯)
- Updated the readme.txt (Mostly just gives guidance on assets packs and the license gunk no one reads hehehehe)

not related to the patch itself, you can now play the previous build if you look at the opt-in beta tab

Enjoy heros!

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h2]Change log:[/h2]
[list]
- Booga Husk's attack charge indicator now blinks when its ready to be fired.
- Rainbow Slug's projectile speed slow down has gone from -33% to -45%.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
- Fixed a bug where Cursed Toy's phases wouldn't reset between runs.
- Fixed a bug where Rusty Lunged Dweller would sometimes stop functioning after the player was revived by the Redemption Flower.
- Fixed a bug where Mr Frown would only function when playing as Booga Ghoul.
- Miscellaneous minor bugs and optimizations made on the back end.
[/list]

[i]For those confused, update 1.0.1 was only released on itch.io to fix an issue with that specifically only effected that platform.[/i]
